claim: On a GitHub-hosted macOS arm64 runner (label macos-15, macOS 15.7.9 build 24G830), adoption-bootstrap run 35875188590 at head 75a6e0d, the PR #94 branch, passed every job. bootstrap-macos: adoption/bootstrap-macos.sh --profile macos-arm64-foundation installed the pinned darwin-arm64 set into a disposable ECO_INSTALL_ROOT, including the pinned embeddinggemma-300M-Q8_0 model (sha256 checked). launchd-agents.sh rendered, linted, bootstrapped and booted out the qdrant and llama-embed LaunchAgents. qdrant health reported 1.19.1. The llama-embed embedding acceptance passed: dimension 768, cosine 0.99944 against the Linux CPU reference vector evidence/artifacts/macos-embed-reference-20260923/, threshold 0.99. The llama.cpp startup log assigns layers to Metal device MTL0, with flash attention on CPU. bootstrap-macos-brew: the Homebrew prerequisite path completed. validate-macos: validators, the adoption test modules (238 tests OK) and a real host_receipts.py record/validate/component_matrix/new_host_grand_list smoke in a throwaway checkout copy passed, on setup-python 3.13.15 and on the runner's system /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6.
limitations: This is native operation on a GitHub-hosted macOS arm64 runner only. It is not acceptance on a user's Mac workstation, which must record its own receipt with host_receipts.py and --second-physical-machine plus an independent review.
platform_profiles[macos-arm64] stays drafted_not_accepted. No macos-arm64 platform_status is changed by this receipt.
The launchd agents ran for the duration of one job in the runner's GUI domain. Persistence across logins, reboots and user sessions was not observed.

The non-gating full python3 -m unittest on this runner ran 2929 tests with 29 failures and 95 errors, recorded as an artifact. Most failures come from macOS's symlinked temp directories (/var/folders and /tmp resolve to /private/...) tripping repository path-containment checks, plus Linux-only tests not skipped on macOS. They are tracked as a follow-up and not claimed as passing.
